## Weekly Parsha / פרשת השבוע

54 weekly Torah portions with 2,911 Breslov Torah connections in Hebrew and English.
Each parsha page includes Likutay Moharan references, Likutay Halachos commentary,
Zohar connections, and teachings from across the Breslov library.

**URL pattern:** https://ajew.org/parsha/{bereishit|noach|lech-lecha|...|haazinu}
**Full listing:** https://ajew.org/parsha

## Topics & Spiritual Themes

Key spiritual topics with curated Breslov teachings:
- **Emunah (Faith):** https://ajew.org/topics/emunah
- **Tefillah (Prayer):** https://ajew.org/topics/tefillah
- **Teshuvah (Return):** https://ajew.org/topics/teshuvah
- **Simcha (Joy):** https://ajew.org/topics/simcha
- **Shalom (Peace):** https://ajew.org/topics/shalom
- **Hisbodedus (Alone Time):** https://ajew.org/topics/hisbodedus
- **Healing:** https://ajew.org/healing-words

---

## About ajew.org

A Jew (ajew.org) is the largest online Breslov Torah library, providing free access
to sacred Jewish texts. The site includes the complete works of Rabbi Nachman of Breslov,
the writings of his closest disciple Rabbi Nosson, the Zohar HaKadosh, Talmud Bavli,
Mishna, Rambam's Mishneh Torah, Tanach, and hundreds of additional texts.

All content is bilingual (Hebrew with English translation) and freely searchable.
The site includes tools for daily study, parsha insights, healing words, Torah GPS navigation,
and an AI-assisted chat for Torah questions.

**Contact:** https://ajew.org/about
**RSS:** https://ajew.org/rss.xml
